title: rubus maranensis
intro: Rubus maranensis, commonly known as the West Indian Raspberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). The health benefits of Rubus maranensis include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues, its anti-inflammatory properties, and its potential to lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, protecting the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rubus maranensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
